text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and hematuria, with urine culture confirming >100,000 CFU/mL Pseudomonas aeruginosa, indicating a urinary tract infection. Glucosuria is present without ketonuria, suggesting possible hyperglycemia. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation for UTI management and evaluation for underlying glycemic control issues.
